title: Origin story: Arachne
description: Arachne was a Lydian maiden whose weaving surpassed all mortals. When she boasted she could out-weave Athena herself and wove a tapestry mocking the gods' misdeeds, the enraged goddess tore it apart and struck her. In despair Arachne hanged herself, but Athena transformed her into the first spider, doomed to weave forever.
